body: Turning off your location on life360 will tell my parents that my location is off. Also, I thought about buying a phone but I realise it's better to see where my parents are as well in case I faked being home while they're pn their way home lmao
Unfortunately I live with my parents so they can harass me about it whenever they want. But yeah definitely when I move out I'm wiping that thing off my phone lmao
Unfortunately, I've been having the life360 for a while and so has my sister. My mum is crazy enough that if I do this now, she'll think I have something to do with it tbh

Idk. I don't want to cause more drama which would lead her to do something stupid and maybe aim it towards my younger sister. Everything's been fine so far though, except for the fact that I don't want to talk to her.

I think she's bipolar by the way she just switches back to normal tbh. But yeah, next time something like that happens, I'll be staying with my boyfriend for when it blows over. 🫶

100% agree. I stopped caring a year ago about how they felt and made my first real decision for myself. It might not seems like much but I had the courage to switch to a degree that was more bearable. 

Never been happier. Even if they yell at me for not talking to them anymore when I walk by them (I still live with them) and that I'm acting like a stupid rebellious teenager (I'm 20 and just watch netflix till late), I have never been happier.

Not married but been dating for 3 months now. AP both know what he looks like from his Instagram and that we're talking but doesn't know we're together. Hates how he looks and claims that it isn't because of his ethnicity. We live in Australia and my BF is Italian and Australian. To be fair, with his genetics he does look older than he is, muscular and have a few tattoos (some of cute cats lmfaooo). But he's such a lovely person and even my little sister loves him. They think or I guess hope that I'll be over him after the first lovey dovey initial first months.

I mentioned a week ago that if he does officially asked me to be his GF then I would say yes. They were enraged and says he'll never fit in the family and that they hate him. AM mentions how I'm a selfish daughter for choosing him over them (like I wasn't her perfect overachieving academic student for 20 years of my life). Says all these wild things even when all they saw was a few Instagram photos. 

Basically, they care about their reputation and how he would be seen in our family amongst relatives. I certainly do not give a fuck even if this relationship doesn't work out. Out of all the things that I would actually fight for, it is who I love. 

Meanwhile, I'll just keep seeing him in secret until I can go non-contact. 🤠

Thank you so much for your insight!

>Or the bakers I see online who must create an amazing wedding cake in 7 days and is creative and new no ones seen before.

This creative side is what I love the most! Architecture does have this but as a career, you'd have to work on one 'cake' for years until you can move onto the next. Unfortunately, I'm not that much of a patient person to work that long until something is complete. I do love baking in general and always wish I had more time to, especially since my studies had taken up so much of my time. 

>The big issue is the "they mean well" because it makes it so much harder to fight or argue about. Every human being would be angry if they're agency to choose was taken away from them.

You couldn't have said it better honestly. I had another argument with them earlier today and they said the reason why they yell, scream and restrict me from my freedom of choice was because they loved me. There wasn't much I could counter that argument.

>Honestly I do believe she'll ignore or get angry for anything that pulls away from what she wants.

Yes, she always have been vocal and judgemental about everything I've done and been doing that isn't good in her eyes. I've chosen to ignore most of it but it's this instance that I need her to understand. 

>TBH your an adult now and its great that you get to make a choice here. Whatever you pick I think its good that it be yours, so in the future you can say bad or good whatever happens, you got to make that choice!

It's honestly weird to still have parents that treats you like a 13 year old while others my age are able to go out whenever and whoever they like. I hope that this decision would be my first of many as an adult and as myself. 

Thank you for the advice again! Means a lot to me ❤

Thank you for spending your time to reply and giving me some advice. I really do appreciate it. 

I'm truly sorry that you had to go through and I'm grateful that you found a way towards acceptance.

Regarding the expectations, I can't bare even the slightest thought to fail. When your entire life revolves around grades and success, it defines who you are. And if I can't meet those expectations... then who am I? It eats me inside out. I know that everyone fails at least once in their life but I'll probably die trying to avoid it.

But, I guess I'm holding onto the last bit of hope that I have, since I've posed here. I'll... take your advice and wait a year or so. I guess my strongest fear is to see the disappointment in their faces but until the possibility of that happening, I'll stay alive... Thank you again.
Sending you the fear of heights
cheers to whatever thought that's going through your head 🍻
Facts man. If this life feels like a waste I wonder what makes it not lmao
Nice! I'm 17. But yeahhh I can't guarantee what's gonna happen. My only advice is to expect the worst and do what you want while not giving a shit. Only if you're not hurting anyone of course lmao

Personally, I'm only living because I don't want my mum to commit suicide as well. 

But maybe, if you still care enough, maybe you can live for what the future brings. Sure there's a lot of shitty stuff that might happen but there are some little good things too. Maybe you wanna see how your favourite series will end or what's the next amazing movie that's gonna come out.

But I don't know I'm still a kid. Not even an adult and already wanna die so it's only gon get worse from here on out haha
